propositions: Deleting committed UUID event files does not reclaim git repository space because blobs remain in history, making physical prune costly without storage benefit
The enrichment queue reduce in overlap/queue.py opens and parses every matching event file per type, causing O(history) read cost that breaches the 20ms drain-gate budget (observed 404-692ms)
A merge-safe removal must rename to a deterministic source-derived path with identical content; removal paired with fresh-UUID adds causes rename/rename conflicts across clones
The queue reduction is latest-wins per event type, and event filenames carry the same monotonic timestamp as event bodies, allowing newest-first suffix reads bounded by O(1) file opens per ticket
Bounding reads via suffix-lazy filename-ordered scans preserves all committed events, maintains invariant I1, and requires no merge-semantics change
